# join a capitalised stand-in with the words around it, XXXURLXXX_poh) and
# writes the original back into the FORM column; the user map of every
# config tags the lowercase form, with the lowercase form as its lemma,

# To add a stand-in, add a line here, rebuild and redeploy (or regenerate the
